name: video_speed
description: Retime a completed video creation. Pass exactly one of `speedFactor` or `preset`. `speedFactor` (0.25-4, constant speed — 2 halves the duration, 0.5 doubles it) is FREE and runs locally via ffmpeg: quality-neutral speeding up, but slow motion below ~0.5x duplicates frames and can judder. `preset` (a named ramp curve) runs on the Magnific GPU service and COSTS CREDITS, billed per second of the SOURCE video duration. Returns a new queued video creation; the source is untouched.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

preset.description: COSTS CREDITS (Magnific GPU service). Named ramp curve instead of a constant speed: impact, speed_up, slow_mo, montage, hero_moment, bullet_time, jumper, flash_in, flash_out. Exactly one of `speedFactor`/`preset` is required.

speedFactor.description: FREE, local ffmpeg, constant speed, 0.25-4. 2 plays twice as fast (halves duration); 0.5 plays half as fast (doubles duration). Exactly one of `speedFactor`/`preset` is required.
